claim: Media Studio main has a bounded current-checkout Flatpak-builder/runtime smoke job using the required Flathub-compatible Freedesktop runtime branch and valid Flatpak filesystem permissions, plus a protected manual VAAPI/NVENC self-hosted hardware matrix. This claim excludes production Flatpak sandbox readiness, host integration readiness, reproducible builds, and universal GPU availability.

output.claim_status: Mostly supported structurally, but the GPU runner contract is incomplete and external execution is unverified.
output.summary: The Flatpak workflow has bounded push-only builder, bundle-install, and in-sandbox runtime steps; the GPU workflow has the required main/repository guard, self-hosted matrix, encoder checks, fallback disabling, and verification markers. Revise the incomplete runner contract before accepting the claim.
material_defects: MEDIUM — packaging/gpu/hardware-smoke.sh fixture command versus docs/ci/gpu-runners.md runner contract: the fixture unconditionally requires FFmpeg's libx264 encoder, but the documented runner requirements only require h264_vaapi or h264_nvenc. A runner satisfying the documented requirements can fail before exercising hardware coverage. Add an exact libx264 preflight and document it, or use explicitly guaranteed fixture encoders.
evidence_gaps: No supplied CI results prove the Flatpak bundle was built, installed, or run, or that either self-hosted matrix entry passed.
The supplied files omit CLI/config defaults, profile definitions, and log-path wiring; verify_results and --hardware-fallback=false mapping cannot be independently confirmed.
Actual gpu-hardware environment protection, runner labels, device access, drivers, and script executable mode are external to the bound files.
supported_claims: .github/workflows/ci.yml: the Flatpak job is push-only, has a 60-minute bound, invokes the Flatpak-builder action, installs the bundle, and runs the packaged command inside Flatpak.
The supplied manifests use Freedesktop 25.08; the packaging parity and xdg-data/kio checks satisfy the stated contract.
.github/workflows/gpu.yml and docs/ci/gpu-runners.md specify manual trusted execution, main-repository gating, backend labels, VAAPI/NVENC devices, and a 30-minute bound.
packaging/gpu/hardware-smoke.sh and src/engine.rs structurally require exact hardware encoder names, disable software fallback, require a nonempty verified output, and reject fallback log markers.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim production Flatpak sandbox or host-integration readiness.
Do not claim reproducible builds from the mutable action/dependency references.
Do not claim universal GPU availability or external CI success.
required_changes: Add libx264 to the explicit GPU runner contract and verify it before fixture generation, or replace the fixture codec with an explicitly checked alternative.
residual_risks: The Flatpak artifact retains broad host permissions and a privileged builder by design; the smoke is push-only and remains experimental.
The GPU proof covers only trusted, manually dispatched VAAPI/NVENC runners.
